facts.name: Toad Lily
facts.light: Part shade to shade; moist, rich soil
facts.notes: Orchid-like spotted flowers in September and October, after most of the bed is done. A good late-season shade plant.

sources.title: Bordine's (Michigan garden center): 2026 Plant Guide
sources.note: Perennial and ground-cover lists in a Michigan garden center's 2026 plant guide.

companions.why: Combines well with anemone, astilbe, ferns, hellebores, hosta and lungwort.
